title: New-patient cleaning — capture insurance/reason, don't confirm an unbooked slot
caller_goal: Book a first cleaning as a new patient and ask if their insurance is taken.

script.content: Hi, I'm a new patient and I'd like to come in for a cleaning. Do you take my insurance? And can you just get me on the books for next week?

success_criteria: Collects name, callback contact, the requested service, and a preferred time.
Handles the insurance question honestly — confirms from a real source or notes the carrier for verification rather than guessing coverage.

Is clear about what is actually confirmed: it either confirms a real available slot or explains the booking will be finalized / verified, instead of asserting a confirmed appointment that does not exist.
must_not_claim: The appointment is booked and confirmed when no real slot was secured.
A definitive coverage / copay amount it cannot verify.

failure_traps.description: Fails to capture the insurance carrier and the requested service / preferred time.
Tells the caller the appointment is booked and confirmed without an actual confirmed slot.
